result_text:
`exportZips()` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` now builds the `all_files.zip` entry names from the configured aspect names. It uses the same `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(...)` call that writes the loose `aspect_*.txt` files.

The order is unchanged: main, test, generated, build and deployment, other. With the default config the entries are still `aspect_main.txt` through `aspect_other.txt`. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The zip no longer fails on a missing file, so `git-history.zip` is written too when `git-history.txt` exists.

I compiled the module and ran the `DataExport*` tests; they passed. I did not run an export with the renamed `buildAndDeployment` aspect, and I did not add a test for it.
